name: quiz_mcq_scaffold
description: Multiple-choice question scaffolds from a text and a list of target terms: the sentence that first uses each term becomes the stem with the term blanked, and distractors are drawn from the other sentences of the same text with part-of-speech heuristics (same number of words, same capitalisation, similar length, same word ending, never a variant of the answer), chosen and shuffled reproducibly from a seed. Returns labelled choices, the answer key and the relaxations used.

input.text: Photosynthesis takes place in the chloroplast. Plants absorb sunlight with chlorophyll and release oxygen. The Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide into sugar. Respiration happens in the mitochondria, where glucose is broken down. Darwin and Mendel studied heredity in very different ways.

questions.stem: Plants absorb sunlight with _____ and release oxygen.

catalog.source: original (distractor heuristics after common item-writing guidance: plausible, homogeneous in form and length)
